annotations.title: Follow links between verses, works and rooms

description: Walk the shelf as a graph from a verse, a work or a room: which works quote a verse, which verses and rooms a work touches, which works a room names, and on again, as many steps as asked (default 1), with the quotation on every edge and a link to open it. Start from "John 1:1" (or "verse:JHN.1.1"), "work:<id>" or "room:<name>". Everything found is returned, in a fixed order; limit and offset are there only if you want to page. It follows the published index: the indexed verses and the Enoch and Melchizedek rooms, so a short answer is the edge of the index, not the edge of the library.

depth.description: How many steps to walk. Default 1.

from.description: Start node: a verse like "JHN.1.1" or "John 1:1", "work:<shelf id>", or "room:enoch" / "room:melchizedek".

limit.description: Optional: return this many edges at a time. Default: all of them.

offset.description: Optional: skip this many edges (use next_offset from the previous answer).

name: follow_links

cite.description: Ready citation naming Scriptura, ending with the link.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.
